name: three-tools
description: Winter in a one-room camp beside a bay, a grove and a well. Staying alive takes three things - fish to eat, firewood to burn, water to drink - and each runs down every tick. Fish, wood and water are plentiful, but you can only fish with a rod in your hand, chop with an axe, and draw water with a bucket, and there are just two of each for the whole camp. Tools are picked up, dropped, or lent hand to hand; goods are given. Everything said and handed over in the room is seen by all. Survive 500 ticks. Built for 6 to 9 players.
